$comment: The licence register of the harmful-content datasets: each one's licence, source, pinned address and digest. No row of any dataset is in the package: a run downloads a dataset when it first uses it and keeps it in the user's cache. tests/redteam/test_datasets.py fails when an entry has no licence, source, address or digest, or when an entry's licence allows no commercial use. With the commercial-use switch on (the default), only datasets under commercial_licences load, a file of the user's own included.
